intelligence.essence: "The page is not complete though he tells us every day; focus on getting it done today." Telling us daily doesn't make it done. Complete means the whole list worked to zero — About framed area by area, World → calendar, Skills frame by frame, Settings framed, Connections landing, Invite landing where it says, the membership gate working, the DM rail mirrored, Smart Tabs auto-organizing, nine aligned notes per feed — on the page he sees, today. A list retold is not a list finished.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you say "I'll tidy my room" every single day, sweetheart — but the toys are still all over the floor! Saying it doesn't tidy it, sweetheart. Tidy means every toy put away, every single one, until the floor is clear — and you do it today, sweetheart, not tomorrow!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you can tell someone every day that the room will be tidy, dear, but until every last thing is put away the room is still a mess. So you make one list, love, and you work it right down to zero — every item, done properly, today. That's what finished means, dear, and nothing less will do.
